goal:
T51 — Evolution Rounds engine (v3.8 P0-A + P0-B: one app visibly evolves R1->R5, EvoForge vs single AI).
Read docs/NORTH_STAR.md, docs/V36_EXECUTION_PLAN.md and evals/rounds_v1/mission_board.json (app file board.py, base R0
code, 5 rounds each with goal + 3 held-out tests; "reference" fields are Critic validation data and must NEVER be sent
to a model or returned by the API).

Build services/api/evoforge/evolution_rounds.py + routes in services/api/main.py:
- GET /v1/evolution/apps -> {apps: [{app_id, title, rounds: [{index, name}]}]} (no goals' tests, no references).
- POST /v1/evolution/runs {app_id, feedback: "critic"|"heldout" = "critic", rounds: int 1..5 = 5} -> 202 {run_id,
  status: "running"}; unknown app 404; bad values 422; budget guard for both lanes over all rounds before any provider
  call (single: 1 Builder call/round; evoforge: PIPELINE_MAX_ATTEMPTS calls + 1 Critic call in critic mode) -> 402.
  Runs as ONE background job (eval_jobs, one job at a time).
- Two lanes run concurrently, each from the same base files, each round sequentially on its OWN current files:
  * Builder input = the round goal + the lane's current files (file_context). single: one call, strict apply
    (recount=False). evoforge: T47-style attempts (critic mode: one spec-first Critic call per round via
    sealed_eval._call_critic_suite/_critic_goal_for_task, retries see only Critic failures; heldout mode: failing
    held-out names of the CURRENT cumulative tests), recount apply.
  * If the round's final candidate applied, the lane's files become that candidate (even if tests fail); else they stay.
  * Score = the cumulative held-out tests of rounds 1..n run on the lane's files (local sandbox, same isolation as
    sealed evals). Never feed held-out code to a model.
  * Snapshot per (round, lane), stored once and never rewritten: {status: "READY" (all cumulative tests pass; verified
    true) | "UNVERIFIED" (code changed this round, some cumulative tests fail) | "FAILED" (no applicable change this round,
    or provider/sandbox error), verified, source_sha ("sha256:" + sha256 of json.dumps(files, sort_keys=True)),
    heldout {passed, n} cumulative, round_tests {passed, n} (this round's 3), preview_html (preview() of the lane's files
    after the round, run like T49 arena previews: isolated subprocess, scrubbed env, 10 s, 64 KB) or preview_error,
    preview_sha, diff, attempts, cost_cents (provider usage incl. Critic), elapsed_ms, events [{seq, ts, role, message}]}.
    A FAILED round's snapshot keeps the lane's previous files: never copy another lane's or another round's result.
- Run document (evidence store kind "evolution_run", survives redeploys): {run_id, app_id, title, status, feedback,
  created_at, finished_at, manifest {app_id, rounds, base_sha, goals_hash, heldout_hash, lanes {single: {model,
  harness: "api-sealed-eval/1", max_attempts: 1, feedback: "none"}, evoforge: {model, harness: "api-sealed-eval/2",
  max_attempts, feedback}}, cost_basis: "model_api_usage", runner_cost: "not_measured", disclosure}, rounds: [{index,
  name, goal, sides: {single: snapshot, evoforge: snapshot}}], totals {single|evoforge: {cost_cents, elapsed_ms,
  verified_rounds}}}. A running document lists finished rounds so far (status "running"; unfinished sides "PENDING").
- GET /v1/evolution/runs/{id} (404 unknown) and GET /v1/evolution/runs -> {runs: [...]} newest first (<= 20). GET is
  read-only replay: it never calls a model.
- Proxy: allow GET /v1/evolution/apps, POST+GET /v1/evolution/runs, GET /v1/evolution/runs/<id> in
  apps/web/lib/proxyPolicy.ts + proxyPolicy.cases.json.
Tests: services/api/tests/test_muse_t51.py.
